recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source fix in active build inputs that completes the applied Jira request without making broader mapping-page or generated-artifact changes.
issue_request: FHIR-47467 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 ballot change request noting that Resource Content version-diff tabs pointed at R4 even though R6 should also compare to the last published release, R5. The Jira resolution accepted the change and noted that mapping/conversion pages are maintained separately and would be updated near final publication.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit dbb78e2435 removed scattered R4 Conversions cross-links from datatype/resource pages as part of the mapping-page cleanup. Later QA commits cc1157b9bb, d1c6910292, and bec9814442 added r5-r6 change metadata, renamed the resource tab from R4 Diff to Version Diff, and added global R5/R6 difference pages, but the active resource/interface templates still rendered only R4/R4B XML/JSON links.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-11-25 record the 10-0-0 Persuasive vote and final-publication timing rationale. Current generated build output already has R5-to-R6 per-resource diff content and patient.r5.diff/resource.r5.diff artifacts, so the remaining mismatch was stale navigation/link prose in source templates and the special Resource/Meta notes.
reconciliation: Changed tools/templates/template.html and tools/templates/template-intf.html so both normal and interface resource pages link to R5, R4, and R4B diff XML/JSON artifacts in the Version Diff tab and All view. Changed source/resource/resource-notes.xml so the special Resource/Meta version-diff notes no longer say Changes since Release 3 and direct readers to Full Difference for R5, R4B, and R4 comparisons.
source_changes: tools/templates/template.html: added R5 XML/JSON links to the resource Version Diff tab and All view alongside R4 and R4B links.
tools/templates/template-intf.html: added the same R5/R4/R4B diff links for interface resource pages.
source/resource/resource-notes.xml: replaced stale Release 3/R4-only wording in the special Resource/Meta notes with version-difference wording and a Full Difference link covering R5, R4B, and R4.
